audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. All weights even iff highest weight even; compact-stabilizer characterization of all cone interiors; All long restricted-root spaces are real one-dimensional; Uniform global quadratic BCH remainder for all root parameters
limitations: M01 — Counterevidence: Actual classification uses extremal weight test; actual Levi modules are symmetric cone models. Benoist Prop4.7 uses highest restricted weight only. No final classification counterexample.
M02 — Counterevidence: Theorem3.4 separately imposes multiplicity1; this group excluded.
M03 — Counterevidence: Polynomial BCH is quadratic on bounded neighborhood. Prop10.10 transfers local estimate; linear projection bound handles large X. Complete repair of Prop10.22(1) given.
